phase: Credit Risk — Mortgage-Portfolio Source Family Screening
purpose: Determine whether official BNR evidence supports a narrower mortgage/housing-loan credit-risk candidate boundary that is more closely aligned to observed borrower-burden measures than the registered aggregate banking-system NPL target. This is source-family screening only: it does not select a new target, digitise charts, estimate a model, or alter the registered mechanism.

registered_mechanism_boundary.current_target: aggregate banking-system gross NPL ratio from ECB CBD2

official_mortgage_npl_evidence.note: BNR states that the NPL ratio for mortgage loans remained at 1.7 percent in September 2023; the report chart separately tracks total, mortgage and consumer-loan NPL.
BNR states that real-estate/mortgage loans had a 1.7 percent NPL ratio in March 2024, versus 5.9 percent for consumer loans and 3.3 percent for household bank loans overall.

borrower_burden_family.source: BNR Bank Lending Survey publication-text DSTI levels
borrower_burden_family.reason: Outstanding-loan DSTI is closer in stock/population concept to a mortgage NPL stock than new-loan DSTI, but exact reporting-population and aggregation compatibility with the NPL source is not yet demonstrated.

dti_at_origination_evidence.source: BNR Financial Stability Report, June 2024 / Central Credit Register reporting
dti_at_origination_evidence.concept: DTI-O = total borrower debt divided by annual disposable income at loan origination
dti_at_origination_evidence.reason: DTI-O is a stock-to-income origination leverage measure, not scheduled debt service relative to income. Limited indicator reporting coverage also prevents treating it as a complete mortgage-portfolio burden series.

portfolio_alignment_assessment.conclusion: Official BNR publications establish a scientifically plausible mortgage-portfolio NPL/DSTI source family, but not yet a definitionally reconciled joint panel. It is evidence for a future separately preregistered sector-specific candidate family, not authorization to replace the registered aggregate NPL target.

required_before_preregistration: Identify and retain a concrete official machine-readable mortgage-NPL source (series key, export endpoint, table or workbook); publication charts alone are insufficient.
Retain an exact machine-readable mortgage NPL history on a frozen BNR definition.
Retain or formally freeze the housing-loan DSTI measurement history and choose new versus outstanding DSTI ex ante.
Demonstrate reporting-population, bank-coverage and weighting compatibility between NPL and burden measures, or document an explicit non-equivalence boundary.
Freeze a mortgage-aligned activity/income observable before fit.
Preregister lag structure and treatment of recognition, cures, write-offs, sales and regulatory breaks.
Define untouched structural-selection and final-evaluation windows before inspecting candidate performance.

prohibited_shortcuts: Digitise BNR NPL charts to manufacture a canonical mortgage NPL history.
Treat DTI-O as debt-service burden or DSTI.
Assume that mortgage NPL and BLS DSTI have identical reporting populations because both concern housing loans.
Choose aggregate versus mortgage NPL after inspecting model fit.
Use new-loan DSTI as an outstanding-loan portfolio burden without a separately frozen design.
Open estimation merely because two publication dates report a mortgage NPL ratio.

screened_surfaces: BNR Central Credit Register information surface
findings: Financial Stability Reports publish mortgage NPL as a distinct series and direct text anchor values.
A BNR interactive-database surface exists, but no exact mortgage-NPL series identifier or export endpoint was identified in the current search.
The Central Credit Register is the source behind several borrower/portfolio indicators, but no public machine-readable mortgage-NPL history endpoint was identified.
machine_readable_source_search.negative_evidence_scope: This is not evidence that no official machine-readable series exists; it records only that no exact series/export endpoint was identified in the screened public surfaces.
machine_readable_source_search.next_trigger: A concrete official series key, downloadable table/workbook, API/export endpoint or reproducible data extract for mortgage NPL.
